description: This Java class 'RegexStringMatcher' is part of the 'org.mockserver.matchers' package and implements regex-based string matching logic for mock server request matching, including handling of notatable strings, schema strings, and logging of regex matching errors.

classes.name: RegexStringMatcher
classes.description: A class that performs regex-based matching for NottableString objects, supporting control plane and data plane distinctions, with detailed logging for regex errors.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overloaded methods to check if a string or NottableString matches the regex or schema conditions.

methods.name: matchesByNottedStrings
methods.description: Checks matching logic when both strings are 'not' strings.

methods.name: matchesBySchemas
methods.description: Checks matching when schema strings are involved.

methods.name: matchesByStrings
methods.description: Performs actual string or regex matching, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the matcher is null or blank.
